notes: Customer: mid-market B2B SaaS (ITSM-ish) building an internal helpdesk chatbot for support agents.
Primary ask: fast subjective response time for agent-facing chat; streaming with tool-calling so agent UI shows suggestions live.
Latency SLO: p95 < 150ms for token availability; chunk/stream latency < 50ms perceived by UI. - quoted on call.
Cost sensitivity: wants to start on Hosted to move quickly, but Dedicated is needed if unit cost at scale and data isolation acceptable.
Security: must retain chat logs for 12 months, provide audit trail for agent actions, SSO (Okta), and KMS integration for keys.
Quote: "We'd rather pay a predictable seat/throughput price once POC meets latency SLOs." - VP Product
use_case_summary: Internal agent chatbot to surface KB answers, auto-fill ticket fields via tool calls, and provide quick triage suggestions. Must integrate with internal ticketing API, show streaming suggestions, and keep an auditable log of assistant actions.
latency_requirements: p95 end-to-end <= 150ms for short replies, streaming chunk latency <= 50ms; tool-calling roundtrip ideally < 200ms (tokenization + API call).
model_preferences: Prefer lightweight open models (7b/13b) for lower cost; fallback plan to quantized 8-bit variants. Interested in Redwood-verified models and automatic fallback to cheaper variants under load.
poc_details: Scope: 3-day hosted API POC using production-like traffic (mix of short agent prompts and multi-step tool-calls).
Metrics: measure p95 latency, streaming chunk delay, tool-call success rate, token cost per conversation.
Success criteria: p95 <= 150ms, tool-calls <= 95% success, cost <= target budget for projected 10k agent sessions/month.
Data: use anonymized internal KB + synthetic tickets; Redwood to provide streaming SDK and example tool-caller hooks.
po_notes_from_se: Ethan: need to run a baseline on current infra (sticky sessions, TLS termination). Ask infra to open ports for POC and provide sample ticketing API sandbox creds.
contract_notes: Legal flagged data residency clause; finance wants 12-month commit option vs month-to-month. Looking for uplift on enterprise support for Dedicated.
sales_playbook_next_actions: 1) Deliver POC env credentials + run scripted load tests. 2) Invite infra to Dedicated sizing call. 3) Put draft term sheet in Drive and loop Legal.
customer_quotes: We need the assistant to be faster than our current KB search flow - speed is the differentiator.
If Dedicated pricing is reasonable we'll consider a 12-month commit — but need predictable unit economics.
